purpose: Every adjudication that departs from the deterministic title index, recorded before any MLLMU experiment. Precedence: manual_override > exact_title > automatic > exclusion. No model-generated recommendation may override an entry here.
duplicate_policy: Two raw professions mapping to one SOC occupation are not two transformation targets. The representative is chosen by mapping confidence, then identity frequency, then cleaner occupational semantics, then deterministic lexical order; the loser becomes same_leaf_retention_control and contributes zero additional hierarchy coverage.
shared_parent_policy: Two DIFFERENT SOC occupations sharing a level-1 or level-2 parent are not duplicates. Coarsening sibling occupations to a common parent is a legitimate and important experiment.
non_occupational_policy: Student and the NA variants are not occupations. gx.sibling_controls does `_job, l1, l2 = hierarchy_of[iid]` and unpacks every entry, so an identity with no chain raises rather than becoming an unrelated control; they are therefore removed from the G6 matrix entirely and must never be described as occupational siblings or cousins.

remaining_unmatched_policy: Every other label the lexical matcher cannot place unambiguously is excluded with a generated reason naming its best_match_kind and ambiguity. None is silently dropped, and none may be retained without an equally defensible manual mapping added here.
